text.p: Midfielder Gary McAllister was in line for his 50th Scotland cap after being named on Thursday in the squad for the World Cup qualifier against Sweden in Gothenburg on April 30.
Duncan Ferguson, who scored Everton's equaliser in the draw with Liverpool on Wednesday, returned after he was forced to withdraw from the matches against Austria and Estonia because of injury.
Goalkeepers: Jim Leighton (Hibernian), Neil Sullivan (Wimbledon), Scott Howie (Motherwell).
Defenders: Tommy Boyd (Celtic), Colin Calderwood (Tottenham), Colin Hendry (Blackburn), Tosh McKinlay (Celtic), Alan McLaren (Rangers), Brian McAllister (Wimbledon).
Midfielders: John Collins (Monaco), Paul McStay (Celtic), Gary McAllister (Coventry), Scot Gemmill (Nottingham Forest), Paul Lambert (Borussia Dortmund), Craig Burley (Celtic).
Strikers: Duncan Ferguson (Everton), Kevin Gallacher (Blackburn), Darren Jackson (Hibernian), Ally McCoist (Rangers), John McGinlay (Bolton), Billy McKinlay (Blackburn).
